research_summary: Verified all 21 official departments across 5 faculty groups and extracted 212 public faculty cards, all 21 published department heads, 21 departmental official emails and 20 departmental office phone values. All 21 heads were cross-checked against the central chair directory. Retained official emails for 207 faculty cards; the remaining five profiles do not publish an eligible official email. Department-linked MSc Engineering and M Engineering programs for CSE and ICE are supported by the 2026-2027 official admission circular. University-wide degree families are recorded separately because the academic-program page does not map every degree to a department. No curriculum download links appeared on the checked department directory pages, and official Academic Ordinance and Evening Programs tables were empty. Institutional counts may be stale or internally inconsistent; records describe source publications.
